request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle percussion, peaceful and hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We are not led by flesh or fear
But by the Spirit who lives near
He raised Jesus from the dead
Now He gives our mortal bodies life ahead

[Pre-Chorus]
We have an obligation to the Spirit
Not to live in the flesh and its grip

[Chorus]
All who are led by the Spirit are children
No more slaves to fear or hidden sins
We cry out Abba Father in the Spirit
He testifies we are God's own children

[Verse]
We received a Spirit of adoption
Not a spirit of slavery or dread
In Him we cry Abba Father loud
The Spirit testifies we are known

[Chorus]
All who are led by the Spirit are children
No more slaves to fear or hidden sins
We cry out Abba Father in the Spirit
He testifies we are God's own children

[Verse]
If we are children then we are heirs
Heirs of God and with Christ we share
Suffering with Him leads to glory
Present pain is not worth the story

[Chorus]
All who are led by the Spirit are children
No more slaves to fear or hidden sins
We cry out Abba Father in the Spirit
He testifies we are God's own children

[Outro]
Creation waits for the revealing of the children
We are heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ
